scenarios.title: Make package metadata visible without installing anything
scenarios.summary: Separate an enabled source, its cached index and package query results.
scenarios.objective: Enable tools using the supplied updates source and cache its current published metadata. Query exact package for parcel and companion. Both must show only the tools candidate from the current snapshot. Inspect candidates only; this task does not install or download packages.
steps: Inspect supplied configuration and cached metadata, perform the required safe changes and queries, then check the whole result.
scenarios.explanation: One valid approach: apply settings for tools using file:///virtual-repositories/updates, enabled; refresh metadata for tools; query parcel; query companion. Read the actual source and cached snapshot. Safe alternative operation orders that meet every requirement also pass.
hints: Compare enabled state, configured source and cached endpoint before refreshing.
A missing cache, a matching older cache and a wrong-source cache explain different outcomes. Read the actual omission or candidate rows.
After the last applied settings or refresh, run both required exact-name queries again. Retain any protected alias configuration/cache.
scenarios.simplifications: Typed virtual repository metadata only. Supplied URI labels are not opened. No actual network, host filesystem, package installation, downloads, trust/signature checks, automatic refresh, full Zypper/Yum CLI or dependency solving. Wrong-source candidate withholding is an explicit simulation policy, not full libzypp conformance.

scenarios.objective: Make tools use the supplied updates source, enabled for queries, with matching current metadata. Refresh explicitly only when the applied source and cached metadata require it.

scenarios.title: Use an older cached index honestly while a source is offline
scenarios.summary: Preserve useful offline evidence without calling it current metadata.
scenarios.objective: Retain tools configuration and its existing cached source/snapshot exactly. The supplied updates delivery fact is Unavailable. Query parcel and companion using the retained older cache. Both actual results must come only from tools. Read the Older snapshot label and recorded version. This is cached evidence, not proof of current remote contents or a successful installation.

scenarios.title: Hand over current package evidence while retaining a held source
scenarios.summary: Repair one repository and preserve another repository’s configuration and cache.
scenarios.objective: Make live use the supplied updates source, enabled with matching current metadata. Keep held disabled at its original address and preserve its original cached source/snapshot. Query parcel and companion after the changes. Each must show only the current live candidate, with no held candidates. Verify both repositories; a successful query for one package is only partial completion.
